types.name: AccessPermission
docs: Compliance status for a (user, role) assignment, set by an admin after
off-chain KYC/AML. Only the marketplace's investor-fund calls (listing,
buying, offers, share transfers, lawyer case work) require this flag on
top of the role; every other instruction checks role possession alone.
Later it'll be driven by a SAS attestation instead of a manual toggle.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.permission`
stores the variant index, so a reorder flips every stored status.

types.name: AgentCandidacy
docs: One agent standing in one election round; carries their own tally.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the candidacy belongs to.

fields.name: vote_power
docs: Share-weighted votes cast for this candidate.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: AgentElection
docs: The running agent election. Any eligible agent may stand; the first
candidacy opens the voting window and shareholders vote among the
candidates. A round that elects nobody simply reopens: rounds repeat
until an agent is engaged. One round at a time per property.

fields.name: expiry
docs: When voting closes; zero while no round is running.

fields.name: candidate_count
docs: Candidates standing in the current round.

fields.name: round
docs: Round number, monotonic per property. Candidacies and vote records
are keyed by it, so nothing stale can count toward a later round.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Quorum at the moment the round opened, so a config change can't move
the goalposts mid-vote.

fields.name: assigned_count
docs: Properties currently assigned to the agent in this location. Leaving
the location requires zero.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The deposit locked when this location was registered, recorded so a
later config change can't reprice the refund.

types.name: AgentVote
docs: One investor's vote in one agent election round. The voting shares stay
locked in the marketplace ShareHolding until the record is closed again
by `unlock_agent_votes`.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the vote belongs to.

fields.name: choice
docs: The candidate voted for.

fields.name: power
docs: The shares this vote locked and counts for.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the record's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: Challenge
docs: A holder's move to strike the sitting agent, backed by an XCAV stake the
challenger loses if the vote goes against them.

fields.name: id
docs: Monotonic per property; vote records are keyed by it.

fields.name: agent
docs: The agent on the seat when the challenge opened; the punishment only
applies while they still hold it.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The challenger's stake, held in the XCAV vault.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Quorum at the moment the vote opened.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: CheckpointEntry
docs: A holder's claim state against the stream at the same index.

fields.name: per_share
docs: The stream's `per_share` the holder is paid or banked up to.

fields.name: pending
docs: Income banked for the holder but not yet paid out, written when a
settle runs ahead of a balance change.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Protocol parameters for the property program.

types.name: GovState
docs: A property's governance ledger: one live proposal and one live challenge
at a time, and strikes against the sitting agent.

fields.name: proposal_count
docs: Ids already used; the next proposal or challenge takes count + 1.

fields.name: active_proposal
docs: The live proposal / challenge id; zero while none. One of each at a
time per property.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Passed challenges against the sitting agent; three remove them.
Reset when a new agent takes the seat.

fields.name: last_auto_approval_ts
docs: When the last request was approved without a vote.

types.name: GovVote
docs: One holder's vote on one proposal or challenge (the seed prefix says
which). The voting shares stay locked in the marketplace ShareHolding
until the record is closed again by the matching unlock instruction.

fields.name: id
docs: The proposal or challenge the vote belongs to.

fields.name: power
docs: The shares this vote locked and counts for.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the record's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: IncomeCheckpoint
docs: One holder's income position on one property. `entries[i]` tracks
`streams[i]`; missing tail entries read as zero.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: IncomeStream
docs: One payment mint's income stream for a property.

fields.name: per_share
docs: Cumulative income per share since the stream opened, in raw token
units. Wide on purpose: a stream lives as long as the property.

fields.name: dust
docs: Remainder of the last distribution below one unit per share, carried
into the next one so nothing is stranded.

types.name: LettingAgent
docs: A letting agent's registry entry, one per wallet. Agents work one region
and any number of its locations up to the cap; each location holds its
own deposit and counts the properties assigned there.

fields.name: region_id
docs: The one region this agent covers.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who funded the account's rent and gets it back at close.

types.name: Location
docs: A registered postcode within a region. Existence is the point: the
marketplace requires a listing's location PDA to exist for its region.

fields.name: postcode
docs: The postcode, as seeded (uppercase ASCII, no spaces).

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked when the location was registered. Released on removal,
even if the configured deposit has changed since.

types.name: PropertyAsset
docs: A fractionalized property. Created when it is listed and kept for the
asset's whole life; the share mint and metadata are attached by
`init_property_assets`.

fields.name: name
docs: Display name, e.g. the street address. Empty until the assets are
initialized.

fields.name: metadata_uri
docs: IPFS URI of the property's documents and images; the canonical
off-chain record the frontend and indexers read.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The Token-2022 share mint. Default until the assets are initialized.

fields.name: location
docs: The registered location (postcode) the property sits in.

fields.name: holder_count
docs: Wallets currently holding shares; teardown completes when it reaches
zero again.

types.name: PropertyIncome
docs: A property's rental income ledger, one stream per payment mint. The
streams never mix: the mints differ in decimals, so one shared
accumulator would misprice payouts across them. The funds sit in the
income vault's token accounts, apart from every other pot, so nothing
else can spend money already owed to holders.

fields.name: streams
docs: Append-only: checkpoints refer to streams by index.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent.

types.name: PropertyLetting
docs: A property's letting seat: who manages it, the election that fills the
seat, and the governance the holders run over the agent. Created by the
first candidacy and kept for the property's life.

fields.name: agent
docs: The assigned agent; default while the seat is vacant.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent.

types.name: Proposal
docs: The assigned agent's request for holder sign-off on spending for the
property. Small requests approve on the spot (cooldown-gated) and never
hit storage; the rest live here for the length of the vote. The money
itself moves off chain, authorized by the `ProposalExecuted` event.

fields.name: id
docs: Monotonic per property; vote records are keyed by it.

fields.name: amount
docs: What they ask for, in quote units.

fields.name: details_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain document describing the work.

fields.name: expiry
docs: When voting closes.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Quorum and approval threshold at the moment the vote opened, so a
config change can't move the goalposts mid-vote. The threshold is
zero below the high tier.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: ProposalExecuted
docs: The authorization the off-chain payment runs on: the SPV pays this
amount from the property's bank account.

types.name: ResignationNotice
docs: An assigned agent's notice that they are stepping down. The seat opens
once the notice period has run, via the `finalize_resignation` crank.

fields.name: agent
docs: The resigning agent, recorded so the crank can release their
assignment even if the seat's state moves on.

fields.name: due_ts
docs: When the resignation takes effect.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: Role
docs: All roles recognised across the realXmarket protocol.
A role is app-level authorization, separate from KYC/compliance. Compliance
lives in [`AccessPermission`], and will eventually be driven by SAS
attestations rather than a manually set flag.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.role` stores the
variant index, so a reorder reinterprets every existing assignment.

types.name: RoleAccount
docs: One (user, role) assignment together with its compliance status.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the account's rent (the assigning admin); every teardown
refunds them, whoever triggers it.

types.name: ShareHolding
docs: The canonical share ledger for one holder of one property. The Token-2022
accounts mirror this; they never lead it.

fields.name: locks
docs: Shares locked by votes, one counter per `LockReason`. Counters are
additive within a reason but overlap across reasons.

fields.name: listed
docs: Shares committed to open secondary listings. Still counted in
`amount` — the seller keeps the ledger, and the income that comes
with it, until the moment of sale — but out of voting and transfers.

types.name: Tally
docs: Share-weighted vote tallies.

types.name: VoteChoice
docs: A vote's direction. Abstain counts toward quorum but neither side.

types.name: marketplace::state::Config
docs: Singleton config holding protocol parameters and the authority.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to update parameters.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement authority; takes over via `accept_authority`.
Two-step so a typo'd address can't brick parameter management.

fields.name: xcav_mint
docs: The XCAV mint listing and lawyer deposits are paid in.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the shared protocol treasury (a multisig on mainnet). Fees are
paid to this key's token accounts; the program never holds them.

fields.name: rent_collector
docs: The sponsor wallet that fronts account rent for investors. Every
position close sends its lamports here, not to the investor.

fields.name: accepted_payment_mints
docs: Mints a property can be priced and paid in. Every entry must be a
same-value GBP stablecoin: prices convert between them by decimal
count alone, so adding a mint of different value would misprice every
open listing.

fields.name: listing_deposit
docs: XCAV a developer locks to list a property.

fields.name: lawyer_deposit
docs: XCAV a lawyer locks to join the registry.

fields.name: min_property_shares
docs: Fewest shares a property may be split into.

fields.name: max_property_shares
docs: Most shares a property may be split into.

fields.name: marketplace_fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee taken from the developer's proceeds, in basis points.

fields.name: investor_fee_bps
docs: Fee an investor pays on top of the share price, in basis points.

fields.name: max_ownership_bps
docs: Largest slice of a property one investor may hold, in basis points.

fields.name: claiming_time
docs: Seconds the claim window stays open once the SPV exists.

fields.name: legal_process_time
docs: Seconds the legal process may run before it expires.

fields.name: lawyer_voting_time
docs: Seconds the SPV lawyer election stays open once the first lawyer claims.

fields.name: min_voting_quorum_bps
docs: Share of a property's supply that must vote for the SPV lawyer election
to be valid, in basis points.

fields.name: next_listing_id
docs: Monotonic id for the next listing.

fields.name: next_share_listing_id
docs: Monotonic id for the next secondary share listing.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to update parameters.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement authority; takes over via `accept_authority`.
Two-step so a typo'd address can't brick parameter management.

fields.name: xcav_mint
docs: The XCAV mint agent deposits are paid in.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the shared protocol treasury (a multisig on mainnet).
Slashes are paid to this key's token accounts; the program never
holds them.

fields.name: rent_collector
docs: The sponsor wallet that fronts account rent for holders. Sponsored
closes send their lamports here, not to the holder.

fields.name: agent_deposit
docs: XCAV an agent locks per location they register in.

fields.name: agent_voting_time
docs: Seconds an agent election stays open once the first candidacy claims.

fields.name: min_voting_quorum_bps
docs: Share of a property's supply that must vote for an agent election to
be valid, in basis points.

fields.name: agent_notice_period
docs: Seconds between an agent's resignation notice and the seat opening.

fields.name: proposal_voting_time
docs: Seconds a spending proposal or challenge vote stays open.

fields.name: low_proposal
docs: Requests at or under this approve without a vote, in quote units.

fields.name: high_proposal
docs: Requests at or over this need the high threshold, in quote units.

fields.name: high_threshold_bps
docs: Yes share of yes+no a high request must reach, in basis points.

fields.name: auto_approval_cooldown
docs: Seconds between auto-approved requests on one property.

fields.name: challenge_deposit
docs: XCAV a challenger stakes against the sitting agent.

fields.name: agent_slash_amount
docs: XCAV slashed from the agent's location deposit per passed challenge.

constants.name: CPI_AUTH_SEED
docs: Signer PDA for CPIs into the marketplace; carries no account data.
